title: The GDN-CC Dataset: Automatic Corpus Clarification for AI-enhanced Democratic Citizen Consultations
reasoning: The paper explicitly addresses ethical concerns regarding the use of LLMs in democratic processes, including transparency, accountability, and the impact of model bias on decision-making. It features a dedicated 'Ethical Considerations' section and evaluates models on their ability to avoid 'over-analysis' (adding content not present in the original text), which is framed as an integrity and ethical requirement for democratic tools.
